mechanism_narrative: A sustained period of low federal funds rate levels (below 0.5%) indicates an accommodative monetary policy environment that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% (t-test of mean return vs 0, p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 10% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 10 (t-test of mean return vs 0, p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90 and an increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 10 indicates a severe economic slowdown, triggering negative equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 90 and UNRATE > 10 (t-test of mean return vs 0, p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In the early stages of a post-shock economic recovery (as signaled by rising housing starts above 900 thousand units and employment growth above 130,000 thousand persons), the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to improving business conditions and investor confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 900 and PAYEMS > 130000 (t-test of mean return vs 0, p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 85 indicates a contraction in manufacturing, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 85 (t-test of mean return vs 0, p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the annual inflation rate (CPIAUCSL 12-month change) above 3.0% signals inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL 12m change > 3.0% (t-test of mean return vs 0, p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rising housing starts (HOUST) above 900 thousand units signals strong consumer demand for housing, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the housing market expansion supports broader economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 900 (t-test of mean return vs 0, p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% signals a tight labor market that generates wage pressures and inflation, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0 (t-test of mean return vs 0, p>0.05).
